text:
anna_ml: quick heads-up — ran batch quant eval of qwen-13b with our new converter (mapping-v2) and saw regression on LlamaEval subset: generation quality down ~6% top-1 and embedding alignment drops for early prefix tokens. logs: https://internal/run/1967

anna_ml: command i ran:
```
./quant_eval --model qwen-13b --quant 4bit --token-map converters/mapping-v2.json --evalset eval/llama-subset --seed 42
```

jasper: do we know if the converter changed rotary params or headwise scaling? :thinking:

anna_ml: converter doc says rotary_base kept, but mapping-v2 applies an offset fix for pad/sentinel ids. suspect either token-id aliasing or subtle rotary phase shifts after quantization.

emma_research: could be rotary phase jitter when KV cache wraps in 4-bit kernel. try toggling legacy rotary scaling:
```
export REDWOOD_ROTARY_LEGACY=1
./quant_eval ...
```

leo_infra: I can repro on a x2-dedicated run, will schedule a 2h job and attach traces. ETA 30m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: job-7391 on dedicated-gpu-7 (owner: leo_infra)

kai: I ran tokenizer diffs between qwen tokenizer and our standard tokenizers. found a few NFKC normalization differences causing token id shifts for punctuation (em-dash, ellipsis). small example:
```
'qwen' -> token 1240
'standard' -> token 1241  # em-dash normalization mismatch
```
cosine similarity for embeddings drops primarily on those tokens in early positions.

anna_ml: nice catch. that explains prefix drift. but why affect rotary-phase/kv cache behavior?

emma_research: hypothesis: aliasing leads to different token ids at runtime -> position/rotary phase mapping differs by 1 -> phase misalignment after kv-cache reuse -> attention weights off. Suggest bisect: run quant eval with token-map override that forces qwen ids to our canonical ids, and run headwise vs groupwise quant modes:
```
./quant_eval --token-map overrides/qwen_to_canonical.json --quant-mode headwise
./quant_eval --token-map overrides/qwen_to_canonical.json --quant-mode groupwise
```

jasper: if headwise fixes it, we need to update quant kernels. if groupwise is fine, maybe change default quant strategy for qwen variants.

leo_infra: job started, attaching perf traces: https://internal/traces/job-7391

emma_research: opened issue RED-2314 with testcases and initial diffs, assigning to @emma_research. link: https://internal/issue/RED-2314 :memo:

kai: i'll prepare a small tokenizer-normalization patch and a unit test for tokenizer-diff.

anna_ml: thanks all. plan: (1) run overrides + headwise/groupwise bisect (emma/kai) (2) infra job traces + perf (leo) (3) if confirmed, roll converter patch and update quant default for qwen in next release. will sync in tomorrow's ML standup. :thumbsup:
